description: evaluate how pull-mode execution may proceed: an explicitly auto-safe, fully validated deterministic next step comes back as a ready-to-submit action definition; anything else returns control to the agent with the blocking reasons.
embedding_description: Ask whether the next work breakdown structure step may run without agent review. Returns auto_safe with a validated closed-world action definition only when the author explicitly marked the step AUTO_SAFE and it is deterministic with fully resolved arguments; otherwise returns agent_review with the reasons, or complete when every step is executed.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Advance evaluation with keys: mode, wbs_id, step_number, reasons, action_definition, envelope
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with mode. For auto_safe present the action_definition the driver may submit mechanically; for agent_review list the reasons; for complete state that the WBS is finished.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: mode='auto_safe': the driver may submit the action_definition without further review, then record the outcome via record_wbs_step_observation. mode='agent_review': read the envelope, decide, and execute manually. mode='complete': the run is closed; no further steps remain.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Evaluating pull-mode advancement under the Q15 rule (auto-submit only validated deterministic steps explicitly marked auto-safe). advance_wbs_execution accepts {wbs_id}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: NotFound: no WBS tracking row or document exists for this wbs_id. ValidationError: the arguments do not conform to the schema, or the stored WBS document fails to parse.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: NotFound: verify the wbs_id. Parse failures: repair the document via patch_work_breakdown_structure. To act on the evaluation, follow output_action_guidance — never submit an action_definition from a mode other than auto_safe without reviewing the envelope.
